explanation.explanation: Panel a is a schematic/micrograph illustrating image cropping, rotation and resizing; it has no quantitative x/y axes requiring units.
Panel b shows schematic cell outlines and micrographs illustrating image spacing; there are no quantitative axes.
Panel c shows micrographs with an inset/zoom illustrating magnification presentation; no quantitative axes are present.
Panel d shows a Min-Max brightness/contrast slider schematic and grayscale micrographs; this is not a plot with quantitative axes.
Panel e shows schematic color-annotation icons and micrographs illustrating channel labeling; there are no quantitative axes.
Panel f shows schematic Venn-like diagrams and grayscale micrographs illustrating channel splitting; there are no quantitative axes.

Panel g includes grayscale and pseudocolor calibration scale bars labeled with numeric intensity values (165, 832, 1,499, 2,165, 2,832) and Min/Max, representing a quantitative color/intensity scale (analogous to a z-axis). Neither the panel nor the caption states the units of these values (e.g., arbitrary units, photon counts, grayscale levels), so the calibration scale lacks defined units.
